mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined by Coleridge as words in their best order and poetry as the best words in their best order."
Prose is defined by Coleridge as words in their best order and poetry as the best words in their best order.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conversation between two people while monologue is a one man conversation."
Monologue Dialogue is a conversation between two people while monologue is a one man conversation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the summary of the events of the novel and in addition, it is the sequence of events as they are brought about by the interaction of character, thoughts, actions and changes in fortunes."
Plot is the summary of the events of the novel and in addition, it is the sequence of events as they are brought about by the interaction of character, thoughts, actions and changes in fortunes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the urge to write, the availability of what to write about and the ability to write fluently to present a coherent story."
The important feature is the urge to write, the availability of what to write about and the ability to write fluently to present a coherent story.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a language that tells us, through a more or less emotional reaction, something that cannot be said."
Poetry is a language that tells us, through a more or less emotional reaction, something that cannot be said.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a word, an object, person or a group of words that retains its meaning and could be used to convey another meaning."
Symbols A symbol is a word, an object, person or a group of words that retains its meaning and could be used to convey another meaning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a play that questions the source of man's adversities."
Theme Whose Fault is a play that questions the source of man's adversities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an imaginative art but, like the Romantics claim, the idea for the play could be found anywhere in the world around us."
Playwriting is an imaginative art but, like the Romantics claim, the idea for the play could be found anywhere in the world around us.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important aspect of the novel."
Realism is a very important aspect of the novel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the subject matter, and the theme, the central idea or that message you want to relate to your reader."
Content is the subject matter, and the theme, the central idea or that message you want to relate to your reader.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the theme, the plot, the language, characterization and the setting."
The basic aspects are the theme, the plot, the language, characterization and the setting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a character in the story we intend to write."
Bayo is a character in the story we intend to write.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the language that produces pictures in the minds of people reading or listening (743)."
Imagery is the language that produces pictures in the minds of people reading or listening (743).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a valuable asset for the creative writer, you can conduct your research, or even look up the meaning of words, check synonyms to enrich your writing."
The internet is a valuable asset for the creative writer, you can conduct your research, or even look up the meaning of words, check synonyms to enrich your writing.
